@echo off
echo ================================================================================
echo Creating Scheduled Task for Auto-Backup
echo ================================================================================
echo.
echo This will create a scheduled task that runs every 5 minutes.
echo You may need to run this as Administrator.
echo.
pause

set BACKUP_DIR=%USERPROFILE%\Desktop\cursor-chat-backups
set TASK_NAME=CursorChatAutoBackup

echo.
echo Creating scheduled task: %TASK_NAME%
echo Task will run: %BACKUP_DIR%\auto-backup.bat
echo Frequency: Every 5 minutes
echo.

schtasks /Create /TN "%TASK_NAME%" /TR "%BACKUP_DIR%\auto-backup.bat" /SC MINUTE /MO 5 /F /RL HIGHEST
if errorlevel 1 (
    echo.
    echo [ERROR] Could not create scheduled task automatically.
    echo.
    echo You need to create it manually:
    echo   1. Press Win+R
    echo   2. Type: taskschd.msc
    echo   3. Click "Create Basic Task"
    echo   4. Name: CursorChatAutoBackup
    echo   5. Trigger: Recurring, Every 5 minutes
    echo   6. Action: Start a program
    echo   7. Program: %BACKUP_DIR%\auto-backup.bat
    echo   8. Finish
    echo.
) else (
    echo.
    echo [SUCCESS] Scheduled task created!
    echo.
    echo Task details:
    schtasks /Query /TN "%TASK_NAME%" /FO LIST | findstr /C:"Status" /C:"Next Run Time" /C:"Task To Run"
)

echo.
pause

file:///g%3A/frappe_docker-main/backup_e.content:
@echo off
setlocal enabledelayedexpansion

echo ================================================================================
echo COMPLETE ERPNext SYSTEM BACKUP
echo ================================================================================
echo.
echo This script will backup EVERYTHING:
echo   - Database (all data, DocTypes, customizations)
echo   - Site files (private/public files, attachments)
echo   - Docker volumes (sites, logs, database)
echo   - Configuration files (docker-compose, site config)
echo   - Custom apps and code
echo.
echo ================================================================================
echo.

REM Check if Docker is running
docker info >nul 2>&1
if %ERRORLEVEL% NEQ 0 (
    echo ERROR: Docker is not running!
    echo Please start Docker Desktop and try again.
    pause
    exit /b 1
)

REM Set paths
set ERP_DIR=C:\Users\pc\frappe_docker
set COMPOSE_FILE=pwd.yml
set SITE_NAME=frontend

REM Get timestamp for backup folder (consistent format: YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS)
for /f "tokens=2 delims==" %%I in ('wmic os get localdatetime /value') do set datetime=%%I
set timestamp=%datetime:~0,4%-%datetime:~4,2%-%datetime:~6,2%_%datetime:~8,2%-%datetime:~10,2%-%datetime:~12,2%
set timestamp_compact=%datetime:~0,4%%datetime:~4,2%%datetime:~6,2%_%datetime:~8,2%%datetime:~10,2%%datetime:~12,2%
set TODAY_DATE=%datetime:~0,4%%datetime:~4,2%%datetime:~6,2%
set CURRENT_TIME=%datetime:~8,2%%datetime:~10,2%%datetime:~12,2%
set BACKUP_ROOT=G:\frappe_docker-main\ERPNext_Backups
set BACKUP_FOLDER=%BACKUP_ROOT%\ERPNext_Backup_%timestamp%

echo [Configuration]
echo --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo   ERPNext Directory: %ERP_DIR%
echo   Compose File: %COMPOSE_FILE%
echo   Site Name: %SITE_NAME%
echo   Backup Location: %BACKUP_FOLDER%
echo.

REM Create backup directory structure
echo [Step 1/11] Creating backup directory structure...
echo --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if not exist "%BACKUP_ROOT%" mkdir "%BACKUP_ROOT%"
if not exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%" mkdir "%BACKUP_FOLDER%"
if not exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database" mkdir "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database"
if not exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\files" mkdir "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\files"
if not exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\volumes" mkdir "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\volumes"
if not exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\config" mkdir "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\config"
if not exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\custom_apps" mkdir "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\custom_apps"
if not exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\customizations" mkdir "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\customizations"
if not exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\logs" mkdir "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\logs"
echo   ✓ Backup directories created
echo.

REM Change to ERPNext directory
cd /d "%ERP_DIR%"

REM Get container names
echo [Step 2/11] Detecting containers...
echo --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
docker compose -f %COMPOSE_FILE% ps -q backend > "%TEMP%\backend_container.txt" 2>nul
set /p BACKEND_CONTAINER=<"%TEMP%\backend_container.txt"
if "%BACKEND_CONTAINER%"=="" (
    echo   ⚠ WARNING: Backend container not found. Trying to start services...
    docker compose -f %COMPOSE_FILE% up -d backend
    timeout /t 10 /nobreak >nul
    docker compose -f %COMPOSE_FILE% ps -q backend > "%TEMP%\backend_container.txt" 2>nul
    set /p BACKEND_CONTAINER=<"%TEMP%\backend_container.txt"
)

docker compose -f %COMPOSE_FILE% ps -q db > "%TEMP%\db_container.txt" 2>nul
set /p DB_CONTAINER=<"%TEMP%\db_container.txt"

if "%BACKEND_CONTAINER%"=="" (
    echo   ✗ ERROR: Could not find or start backend container
    echo   Please ensure ERPNext is running: docker compose -f %COMPOSE_FILE% up -d
    pause
    exit /b 1
)

echo   ✓ Backend container: %BACKEND_CONTAINER:~0,12%...
if not "%DB_CONTAINER%"=="" (
    echo   ✓ Database container: %DB_CONTAINER:~0,12%...
)
echo.

REM Backup database using bench backup - FORCE FRESH BACKUP
echo [Step 3/11] Creating fresh database backup (this may take a few minutes)...
echo --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

echo   Current date/time: %TODAY_DATE%_%CURRENT_TIME% (YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS format)
echo   Creating fresh backup NOW...
echo   Running bench backup command (this will create a NEW backup file)...

REM Record start time
set BACKUP_START_TIME=%time%

REM Run bench backup - this creates a NEW backup file
echo   Starting bench backup process...
docker compose -f %COMPOSE_FILE% exec -T backend bench --site %SITE_NAME% backup --with-files --compress > "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\logs\bench_backup.log" 2>&1
set BENCH_EXIT_CODE=%ERRORLEVEL%

if %BENCH_EXIT_CODE% EQU 0 (
    echo   ✓ Bench backup command completed
    echo   Waiting for backup file to be created and verified...
    
    REM Wait/retry logic: Wait up to 60 seconds for backup file to appear and be complete
    set WAIT_COUNT=0
    set MAX_WAIT=30
    set BACKUP_FOUND=NO
    set BACKUP_VERIFIED=NO
    
    :wait_for_backup
    REM Get the newest backup file (sorted by modification time)
    docker exec %BACKEND_CONTAINER% bash -c "ls -1t /home/frappe/frappe-bench/sites/%SITE_NAME%/private/backups/*.sql.gz 2>/dev/null | head -1" > "%TEMP%\newest_backup.txt" 2>nul
    set /p NEWEST_BACKUP=<"%TEMP%\newest_backup.txt"
    set NEWEST_BACKUP=%NEWEST_BACKUP: =%
    
    if not "%NEWEST_BACKUP%"=="" (
        REM Extract filename
        for %%F in ("%NEWEST_BACKUP%") do set NEWEST_FILE=%%~nxF
        
        REM Check if it's from today (format: YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS)
        echo %NEWEST_FILE% | findstr "%TODAY_DATE%" >nul 2>&1
        if !ERRORLEVEL! EQU 0 (
            set BACKUP_FOUND=YES
            
            REM Verify file size (should be > 0 bytes, typically > 100KB)
            docker exec %BACKEND_CONTAINER% bash -c "stat -c%%s '%NEWEST_BACKUP%' 2>/dev/null" > "%TEMP%\backup_size.txt" 2>nul
            set /p BACKUP_SIZE=<"%TEMP%\backup_size.txt"
            set BACKUP_SIZE=%BACKUP_SIZE: =%
            
            if not "%BACKUP_SIZE%"=="" (
                REM Check if file size is reasonable (> 100KB = 102400 bytes)
                if !BACKUP_SIZE! GTR 102400 (
                    echo   ✓ Backup file found: %NEWEST_FILE%
                    echo   ✓ File size verified: %BACKUP_SIZE% bytes (~%BACKUP_SIZE:~0,-3% KB)
                    echo   ✓ Date verified: Matches today (%TODAY_DATE%)
                    set BACKUP_VERIFIED=YES
                    goto :backup_verified
                ) else (
                    echo   ⚠ Backup file exists but size is too small: %BACKUP_SIZE% bytes
                    echo   Waiting for backup to complete...
                )
            ) else (
                echo   ⚠ Could not verify backup file size, waiting...
            )
        ) else (
            echo   ⚠ Found backup file but date doesn't match today: %NEWEST_FILE%
            echo   Expected date prefix: %TODAY_DATE%
            echo   Waiting for today's backup to be created...
        )
    ) else (
        echo   ⚠ Backup file not found yet, waiting... (%WAIT_COUNT%/%MAX_WAIT%)
    )
    
    set /a WAIT_COUNT+=1
    if !WAIT_COUNT! LSS %MAX_WAIT% (
        timeout /t 2 /nobreak >nul
        goto :wait_for_backup
    )
    
    REM If we get here, backup wasn't verified
    if "%BACKUP_FOUND%"=="YES" (
        echo   ⚠ WARNING: Backup file found but verification incomplete
        echo   File: %NEWEST_FILE%
        echo   Will use this backup but recommend manual verification
    ) else (
        echo   ⚠ WARNING: Could not find fresh backup file after waiting
        echo   Will create direct database dump as fallback...
        goto :create_direct_dump
    )
    
    :backup_verified
    echo   ✓✓✓ FRESH BACKUP VERIFIED: Date and size check passed ✓✓✓
) else (
    :create_direct_dump
    echo   ⚠ WARNING: Bench backup command failed or verification incomplete
    echo   Attempting direct database dump (always fresh)...
    
    REM Try mysqldump as fallback - this ALWAYS creates fresh backup
    echo   Creating fresh database dump using mysqldump...
    set DUMP_FILE=FRESH_BACKUP_%TODAY_DATE%_%CURRENT_TIME%.sql
    docker compose -f %COMPOSE_FILE% exec -T db mysqldump -u root -padmin --all-databases --single-transaction --routines --triggers > "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database\backups\%DUMP_FILE%" 2>"%BACKUP_FOLDER%\logs\mysqldump.log"
    
    if %ERRORLEVEL% EQU 0 (
        REM Verify dump file size
        for %%F in ("%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database\backups\%DUMP_FILE%") do set DUMP_SIZE=%%~zF
        if !DUMP_SIZE! GTR 102400 (
            echo   ✓✓✓ FRESH database dump created: %DUMP_FILE% ✓✓✓
            echo   ✓ File size: %DUMP_SIZE% bytes (~%DUMP_SIZE:~0,-3% KB)
            echo   ✓ This is a FRESH backup with current data from %TODAY_DATE%_%CURRENT_TIME%
        ) else (
            echo   ⚠ WARNING: Dump file created but size is suspicious: %DUMP_SIZE% bytes
            echo   Check logs: %BACKUP_FOLDER%\logs\mysqldump.log
        )
    ) else (
        echo   ✗ ERROR: Database backup failed!
        echo   Check logs: %BACKUP_FOLDER%\logs\mysqldump.log
    )
)
echo.

REM Copy ONLY THE FRESHEST backup file from container (created just now)
echo [Step 4/11] Copying FRESH backup files from container...
echo --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
set BACKUP_SOURCE=/home/frappe/frappe-bench/sites/%SITE_NAME%/private/backups

REM Create backups directory
if not exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database\backups" mkdir "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database\backups"

echo   Looking for backup files from TODAY (%TODAY_DATE%)...

REM Get the LATEST backup file from TODAY (sorted by modification time, newest first)
REM Filter by today's date to ensure we only get fresh backups
docker exec %BACKEND_CONTAINER% bash -c "ls -1t %BACKUP_SOURCE%/*%TODAY_DATE%*.sql.gz 2>/dev/null | head -1" > "%TEMP%\today_backup.txt" 2>nul
set /p TODAY_BACKUP=<"%TEMP%\today_backup.txt"
set TODAY_BACKUP=%TODAY_BACKUP: =%

REM If no backup from today, get the absolute latest (just created)
if "%TODAY_BACKUP%"=="" (
    echo   No backup found with today's date, getting latest backup file...
    docker exec %BACKEND_CONTAINER% bash -c "ls -1t %BACKUP_SOURCE%/*.sql.gz 2>/dev/null | head -1" > "%TEMP%\latest_backup.txt" 2>nul
    set /p LATEST_BACKUP=<"%TEMP%\latest_backup.txt"
    set LATEST_BACKUP=%LATEST_BACKUP: =%
    set BACKUP_TO_USE=%LATEST_BACKUP%
) else (
    set BACKUP_TO_USE=%TODAY_BACKUP%
)

if not "%BACKUP_TO_USE%"=="" (
    echo   Found backup: %BACKUP_TO_USE%
    REM Extract just the filename (handle full path)
    for %%F in ("%BACKUP_TO_USE%") do set BACKUP_FILE=%%~nxF
    
    REM Get file size before copying
    docker exec %BACKEND_CONTAINER% bash -c "stat -c%%s '%BACKUP_TO_USE%' 2>/dev/null" > "%TEMP%\source_size.txt" 2>nul
    set /p SOURCE_SIZE=<"%TEMP%\source_size.txt"
    set SOURCE_SIZE=%SOURCE_SIZE: =%
    
    REM Copy the backup file
    echo   Copying FRESH backup: %BACKUP_FILE%
    echo   Source file size: %SOURCE_SIZE% bytes (~%SOURCE_SIZE:~0,-3% KB)
    docker cp %BACKEND_CONTAINER%:%BACKUP_TO_USE% "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database\backups\%BACKUP_FILE%" 2>nul
    
    if %ERRORLEVEL% EQU 0 (
        REM Verify copied file size matches source
        for %%F in ("%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database\backups\%BACKUP_FILE%") do set COPIED_SIZE=%%~zF
        
        if "%COPIED_SIZE%"=="%SOURCE_SIZE%" (
            echo   ✓ Database backup copied successfully
            echo   ✓ File size verified: %COPIED_SIZE% bytes (~%COPIED_SIZE:~0,-3% KB)
            
            REM Verify it's from today
            echo %BACKUP_FILE% | findstr "%TODAY_DATE%" >nul 2>&1
            if !ERRORLEVEL! EQU 0 (
                echo   ✓✓✓ VERIFIED: Backup is from TODAY (%TODAY_DATE%) - FRESH DATA! ✓✓✓
                set BACKUP_IS_FRESH=YES
            ) else (
                echo   ⚠ WARNING: Backup file date doesn't match today
                echo   Backup file: %BACKUP_FILE%
                echo   Today's date: %TODAY_DATE%
                echo   This backup may contain OLD data!
                set BACKUP_IS_FRESH=NO
            )
        ) else (
            echo   ⚠ WARNING: File size mismatch after copy
            echo   Source: %SOURCE_SIZE% bytes, Copied: %COPIED_SIZE% bytes
        )
        
        REM Also copy matching files.tgz if exists
        set FILES_BACKUP=%BACKUP_FILE:.sql.gz=-files.tgz%
        docker cp %BACKEND_CONTAINER%:%BACKUP_SOURCE%/%FILES_BACKUP% "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database\backups\%FILES_BACKUP%" >nul 2>&1
        if %ERRORLEVEL% EQU 0 (
            echo   ✓ Files backup copied: %FILES_BACKUP%
        )
        
        REM Copy site_config_backup.json if exists
        set CONFIG_BACKUP=%BACKUP_FILE:.sql.gz=-site_config_backup.json%
        docker cp %BACKEND_CONTAINER%:%BACKUP_SOURCE%/%CONFIG_BACKUP% "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database\backups\%CONFIG_BACKUP%" >nul 2>&1
        if %ERRORLEVEL% EQU 0 (
            echo   ✓ Config backup copied: %CONFIG_BACKUP%
        )
    ) else (
        echo   ✗ ERROR: Could not copy backup file
        echo   Trying alternative: Direct database dump...
        goto :create_direct_dump
    )
) else (
    :create_direct_dump
    echo   ✗ ERROR: Could not find any backup files
    echo   Creating direct database dump as fallback...
    
    REM Create direct dump - this is ALWAYS fresh
    set DUMP_FILE=FRESH_BACKUP_%TODAY_DATE%_%CURRENT_TIME%.sql
    docker compose -f %COMPOSE_FILE% exec -T db mysqldump -u root -padmin --all-databases --single-transaction --routines --triggers > "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database\backups\%DUMP_FILE%" 2>"%BACKUP_FOLDER%\logs\direct_dump.log"
    if %ERRORLEVEL% EQU 0 (
        for %%F in ("%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database\backups\%DUMP_FILE%") do set DUMP_SIZE=%%~zF
        if !DUMP_SIZE! GTR 102400 (
            echo   ✓✓✓ FRESH backup created: %DUMP_FILE% ✓✓✓
            echo   ✓ File size: %DUMP_SIZE% bytes (~%DUMP_SIZE:~0,-3% KB)
            echo   ✓ This backup contains CURRENT DATA from %TODAY_DATE%_%CURRENT_TIME%
            set BACKUP_IS_FRESH=YES
        ) else (
            echo   ⚠ WARNING: Dump file size is suspicious: %DUMP_SIZE% bytes
        )
    ) else (
        echo   ✗ ERROR: All backup methods failed!
    )
)
echo.

REM Export customizations as JSON (Scripts, DocTypes as separate files)
echo [Step 5/11] Exporting ALL customizations (DocTypes, Scripts, Fields, Settings, Users, etc.)...
echo --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
REM Copy export script to container
set SCRIPT_DIR=%~dp0
set CUSTOMIZATIONS_EXPORTED=NO

if exist "%SCRIPT_DIR%export_customizations.py" (
    echo   Copying export script to container...
    docker cp "%SCRIPT_DIR%export_customizations.py" %BACKEND_CONTAINER%:/tmp/export_customizations.py >nul 2>&1
    if %ERRORLEVEL% EQU 0 (
        echo   ✓ Export script copied
        echo   Running comprehensive export script...
        echo   This will export: Scripts, DocTypes, Fields, Settings, Users, Roles, etc.
        
        REM Run export script via bench console using Python directly
        docker exec %BACKEND_CONTAINER% bash -c "cd /home/frappe/frappe-bench && python3 -c \"import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '/home/frappe/frappe-bench'); import frappe; frappe.init(site='%SITE_NAME%'); frappe.connect(); exec(open('/tmp/export_customizations.py').read())\"" > "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\logs\customizations_export.log" 2>&1
        
        REM Wait a moment for export to complete
        timeout /t 2 /nobreak >nul
        
        REM Copy exported customizations
        echo   Copying exported customizations...
        docker cp %BACKEND_CONTAINER%:/tmp/customizations_export "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\customizations" >nul 2>&1
        if %ERRORLEVEL% EQU 0 (
            REM Verify export was successful
            if exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\customizations\export_summary.json" (
                echo   ✓ Customizations exported successfully
                echo   ✓ Export summary created
                
                REM Count exported files
                set /a EXPORT_COUNT=0
                for %%F in ("%BACKUP_FOLDER%\customizations\*.json") do set /a EXPORT_COUNT+=1
                echo   ✓ Exported %EXPORT_COUNT% JSON files
                
                REM List key exports
                if exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\customizations\client_scripts.json" (
                    echo   ✓ Client Scripts exported as separate JSON file
                )
                if exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\customizations\server_scripts.json" (
                    echo   ✓ Server Scripts exported as separate JSON file
                )
                if exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\customizations\doctype_definitions_complete.json" (
                    echo   ✓ DocType definitions exported as separate JSON file
                )
                if exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\customizations\custom_fields.json" (
                    echo   ✓ Custom Fields exported as separate JSON file
                )
                
                set CUSTOMIZATIONS_EXPORTED=YES
            ) else (
                echo   ⚠ WARNING: Export completed but summary file not found
            )
        ) else (
            echo   ⚠ WARNING: Could not copy exported customizations
        )
    ) else (
        echo   ⚠ WARNING: Could not copy export script to container
    )
) else (
    echo   ⚠ WARNING: Export script not found at: %SCRIPT_DIR%export_customizations.py
)

REM Fallback: Use bench export-customizations if Python script failed
if "%CUSTOMIZATIONS_EXPORTED%"=="NO" (
    echo   Trying bench export-customizations as fallback...
    docker exec %BACKEND_CONTAINER% bash -c "cd /home/frappe/frappe-bench && bench --site %SITE_NAME% export-customizations /tmp/customizations_export_fallback" > "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\logs\bench_export.log" 2>&1
    docker cp %BACKEND_CONTAINER%:/tmp/customizations_export_fallback "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\customizations" >nul 2>&1
    if %ERRORLEVEL% EQU 0 (
        echo   ✓ Customizations exported using bench export-customizations

    echo   ✓ Server Scripts exported as separate JSON file

import time
import threading
from pynput.keyboard import Controller
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import scrolledtext, messagebox

# Initialize the keyboard controller
keyboard = Controller()

# Initialize typing speed (delay between characters in seconds)
typing_speed = 0.05  # Default: 0.05 seconds between characters

# Function to type a sentence
def type_sentence(sentence):
    """Types the given sentence character by character"""
    global typing_speed
    for char in sentence:
        keyboard.type(char)
        time.sleep(typing_speed)  # Delay between characters

# Function to handle the submit action
def submit_sentence():
    sentence = sentence_entry.get("1.0", tk.END).strip()
    
    if not sentence:
        messagebox.showwarning("Warning", "Please enter a sentence to type.")
        return
    
    # Get delay time
    try:
        delay = int(delay_entry.get().strip())
        if delay < 0:
            raise ValueError("Delay must be a positive number")
    except ValueError:
        messagebox.showerror("Error", "Please enter a valid delay time (in seconds).")
        return
    
    # Disable the submit button during countdown
    submit_button.config(state='disabled')
    
    # Update status
    status_label.config(text=f"Starting in {delay}s...", fg="orange")
    root.update()
    
    # Run the typing sequence in a separate thread
    typing_thread = threading.Thread(target=countdown_and_type, args=(sentence, delay))
    typing_thread.daemon = True
    typing_thread.start()

def countdown_and_type(sentence, delay):
    """Countdown for specified seconds, then type the sentence"""
    # Countdown from delay to 1
    for remaining in range(delay, 0, -1):
        status_label.config(text=f"Starting in {remaining}s...", fg="orange")
        root.update()
        time.sleep(1)
    
    # Final message
    status_label.config(text="Typing...", fg="green")
    root.update()
    
    # Type the sentence
    time.sleep(0.5)  # Small delay before typing starts
    type_sentence(sentence)
    
    # Update status
    status_label.config(text="Done!", fg="blue")
    root.update()
    
    # Re-enable the submit button
    submit_button.config(state='normal')

# Function to clear the sentence field
def clear_sentence():
    sentence_entry.delete("1.0", tk.END)

# Function to increase typing speed (decrease delay)
def increase_speed():
    global typing_speed
    if typing_speed > 0.01:  # Minimum delay of 0.01 seconds
        typing_speed -= 0.01
        typing_speed = round(typing_speed, 2)  # Round to 2 decimal places
        update_speed_display()

# Function to decrease typing speed (increase delay)
def decrease_speed():
    global typing_speed
    if typing_speed < 1.0:  # Maximum delay of 1.0 seconds
        typing_speed += 0.01
        typing_speed = round(typing_speed, 2)  # Round to 2 decimal places
        update_speed_display()

# Function to update the speed display label
def update_speed_display():
    global typing_speed
    cps = round(1.0 / typing_speed, 1) if typing_speed > 0 else 0
    speed_display_label.config(text=f"{cps} chars/sec")

# Create the main window
root = tk.Tk()
root.title("Sentence Typer")
root.geometry("500x350")

# Create main frame
main_frame = tk.Frame(root, padx=15, pady=15)
main_frame.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

# Controls frame - compact layout
controls_frame = tk.Frame(main_frame)
controls_frame.pack(pady=(0, 8))

# Delay
tk.Label(controls_frame, text="Delay:", font=("Arial", 10)).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=(0, 5))
delay_entry = tk.Entry(controls_frame, font=("Arial", 10), width=5, justify='center')
delay_entry.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=(0, 15))
delay_entry.insert(0, "4")

# Speed
tk.Label(controls_frame, text="Speed:", font=("Arial", 10)).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=(0, 5))
decrease_speed_button = tk.Button(controls_frame, text="−", command=decrease_speed, font=("Arial", 10), bg="lightcoral", fg="white", width=2)
decrease_speed_button.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=2)
speed_display_label = tk.Label(controls_frame, text="20.0", font=("Arial", 10), fg="blue", width=6)
speed_display_label.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=2)
increase_speed_button = tk.Button(controls_frame, text="+", command=increase_speed, font=("Arial", 10), bg="lightgreen", fg="white", width=2)
increase_speed_button.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=2)

# Sentence entry field
sentence_entry = scrolledtext.ScrolledText(main_frame, wrap=tk.WORD, width=55, height=6, font=("Consolas", 10))
sentence_entry.pack(pady=(0, 8), fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
sentence_entry.focus()

# Buttons and status frame

    def on_model_change(self, event=None):
        """Handle model selection change"""
        if self.is_listening:
            messagebox.showwarning("Warning", "Please stop recording before changing model!")
            return
        self.model_name = self.model_var.get()
        self.reload_model()
        
    def reload_model(self):
        """Reload the Whisper model"""
        if self.is_listening:
            messagebox.showwarning("Warning", "Please stop recording before reloading model!")
            return
        self.model = None
        self.load_model()
        
    def toggle_recording(self):
        """Start or stop recording"""
        if not self.is_listening:
            self.start_recording()
        else:
            self.stop_recording()
            
    def start_recording(self):
        """Start recording audio"""
        if not self.model:
            messagebox.showwarning("Warning", "Model is still loading. Please wait...")
            return
            
        self.is_listening = True
        self.recording = True
        self.audio_data = []
        
        self.listen_button.config(
            text="⏹️ Stop Recording",
            bg='#f44336',
            activebackground='#da190b'
        )
        self.status_label.config(text="Recording... Speak now!", fg='#f44336')
        self.mic_status_label.config(fg='#f44336')
        
        # Start recording in a separate thread
        self.record_thread = threading.Thread(target=self.record_audio, daemon=True)
        self.record_thread.start()
        
    def stop_recording(self):
        """Stop recording and transcribe"""
        self.recording = False
        self.is_listening = False
        
        self.listen_button.config(
            text="🎤 Start Recording",
            bg='#4CAF50',
            activebackground='#45a049'
        )
        self.status_label.config(text="Processing audio...", fg='#FF9800')
        self.mic_status_label.config(fg='#666666')
        
        # Process audio in separate thread
        threading.Thread(target=self.transcribe_audio, daemon=True).start()
        
    def record_audio(self):
        """Record audio from microphone"""
        try:
            def audio_callback(indata, frames, time, status):
                if self.recording:
                    self.audio_data.append(indata.copy())
                    
            with sd.InputStream(
                samplerate=self.sample_rate,
                channels=1,
                dtype='float32',
                callback=audio_callback
            ):
                while self.recording:
                    sd.sleep(100)
                    
        except Exception as e:
            self.root.after(0, lambda: self.show_error(f"Recording error: {str(e)}"))
            self.is_listening = False
            
    def transcribe_audio(self):
        """Transcribe recorded audio using Whisper"""
        try:
            if not self.audio_data:
                self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_label.config(
                    text="No audio recorded", fg='#888888'
                ))
                return
                
            # Convert audio data to numpy array
            audio_array = np.concatenate(self.audio_data, axis=0)
            audio_array = audio_array.flatten()
            
            # Normalize audio
            audio_array = audio_array / np.max(np.abs(audio_array))
            
            # Transcribe using Whisper
            result = self.model.transcribe(
                audio_array,
                language=None,  # Auto-detect language
                task="transcribe"
            )
            
            text = result["text"].strip()
            
            # Update UI in main thread
            if text:
                self.root.after(0, lambda: self.append_text(text))
                self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_label.config(
                    text="Transcription complete!", fg='#4CAF50'
                ))
            else:
                self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_label.config(
                    text="No speech detected", fg='#888888'
                ))
                
        except Exception as e:
            self.root.after(0, lambda: self.show_error(f"Transcription error: {str(e)}"))
            
    def append_text(self, text):
        """Append transcribed text to the text area"""
        if text.strip():
            current_text = self.text_area.get("1.0", tk.END)
            if current_text.strip():
                self.text_area.insert(tk.END, " " + text)
            else:
                self.text_area.insert(tk.END, text)
            self.text_area.see(tk.END)
            
    def clear_text(self):
        """Clear the text area"""
        self.text_area.delete("1.0", tk.END)
        self.status_label.config(text="Text cleared", fg='#888888')
        
    def copy_text(self):
        """Copy text to clipboard"""
        text = self.text_area.get("1.0", tk.END).strip()
        if text:
            pyperclip.copy(text)
            self.status_label.config(text="Text copied to clipboard!", fg='#4CAF50')
            messagebox.showinfo("Success", "Text copied to clipboard!")
        else:
            messagebox.showwarning("Warning", "No text to copy!")
            
    def save_text(self):
        """Save text to file"""
        text = self.text_area.get("1.0", tk.END).strip()
        if not text:
            messagebox.showwarning("Warning", "No text to save!")
            return
            
        filename = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(
            defaultextension=".txt",
            filetypes=[("Text files", "*.txt"), ("All files", "*.*")],
            initialfile=f"voice_typer_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}.txt"
        )
        
        if filename:
            try:
                with open(filename, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                    f.write(text)
                self.status_label.config(text=f"Saved to {os.path.basename(filename)}", fg='#4CAF50')
                messagebox.showinfo("Success", f"Text saved to {filename}")
            except Exception as e:
                messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Failed to save file: {str(e)}")
                
    def show_error(self, message):
        """Show error message"""
        self.status_label.config(text=f"Error: {message}", fg='#f44336')
        messagebox.showerror("Error", message)

def main():
    """Main function"""
    root = tk.Tk()
    app = VoiceTyper(root)
    root.mainloop()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    def toggle_recording(self):

    def start_recording(self):
        """Start recording audio with real-time transcription"""
        if not self.model:
            messagebox.showwarning("Warning", "Model is still loading. Please wait...")
            return
            
        self.is_listening = True
        self.recording = True
        self.audio_data = []
        self.transcription_buffer = []
        self.last_transcription_time = time.time()
        
        self.listen_button.config(
            text="⏹️ Stop Recording (F7)",

        )

        self.mic_status_label.config(fg='#f44336')
        
        # Start recording in a separate thread
        self.record_thread = threading.Thread(target=self.record_audio_realtime, daemon=True)
        self.record_thread.start()
        
        # Start real-time transcription processor
        self.transcription_thread = threading.Thread(target=self.process_realtime_transcription, daemon=True)
        self.transcription_thread.start()
        
    def stop_recording(self):
        """Stop recording"""
        self.recording = False
        self.is_listening = False
        
        self.listen_button.config(
            text="🎤 Start Recording (F7)",
            bg='#4CAF50',
            activebackground='#45a049'
        )
        self.status_label.config(text="Stopped. Final transcription...", fg='#FF9800')
        self.mic_status_label.config(fg='#666666')
        
        # Process any remaining audio
        if self.audio_data:
            threading.Thread(target=self.transcribe_final_audio, daemon=True).start()
        
    def record_audio_realtime(self):
        """Record audio continuously and queue chunks for real-time transcription"""
        try:
            chunk_samples = self.sample_rate * self.chunk_duration  # Samples per chunk
            current_chunk = []
            chunk_sample_count = 0
            
            def audio_callback(indata, frames, time, status):
                if self.recording:
                    current_chunk.append(indata.copy())
                    nonlocal chunk_sample_count
                    chunk_sample_count += frames
                    
                    # When chunk is ready, queue it for transcription
                    if chunk_sample_count >= chunk_samples:
                        chunk_audio = np.concatenate(current_chunk, axis=0)
                        if len(chunk_audio) > 0:
                            self.audio_queue.put(chunk_audio.copy())
                        current_chunk.clear()
                        chunk_sample_count = 0
                    
            with sd.InputStream(
                samplerate=self.sample_rate,
                channels=1,
                dtype='float32',
                callback=audio_callback,
                blocksize=self.sample_rate // 10  # Process in small blocks
            ):
                while self.recording:
                    sd.sleep(100)
                    
            # Process any remaining audio when stopping
            if current_chunk:
                chunk_audio = np.concatenate(current_chunk, axis=0)
                if len(chunk_audio) > 0:
                    self.audio_queue.put(chunk_audio.copy())
                    
        except Exception as e:
            self.root.after(0, lambda: self.show_error(f"Recording error: {str(e)}"))
            self.is_listening = False
            
    def process_realtime_transcription(self):
        """Process audio chunks in real-time and transcribe continuously"""
        while self.is_listening or not self.audio_queue.empty():
            try:
                # Get audio chunk from queue (with timeout)
                try:
                    audio_chunk = self.audio_queue.get(timeout=0.5)
                except queue.Empty:
                    continue
                
                if audio_chunk is None or len(audio_chunk) == 0:
                    continue
                
                # Normalize audio
                audio_array = audio_chunk.flatten()
                if len(audio_array) == 0:
                    continue
                    
                max_val = np.max(np.abs(audio_array))
                if max_val > 0:
                    audio_array = audio_array / max_val
                
                # Transcribe chunk with optimizations for speed
                try:
                    # Use faster settings for Google Docs-like responsiveness
                    result = self.model.transcribe(
                        audio_array,
                        language=None,
                        task="transcribe",
                        fp16=self.use_gpu and self.fast_mode,  # Use FP16 on GPU for 2x speed
                        beam_size=1 if self.fast_mode else 5,  # Smaller beam = faster
                        best_of=1 if self.fast_mode else 5,  # Single pass = faster
                        temperature=0.0,  # Deterministic, faster
                        compression_ratio_threshold=2.4,  # Skip if likely not speech
                        logprob_threshold=-1.0,  # Skip low confidence
                        no_speech_threshold=0.6,  # Skip silence faster
                        condition_on_previous_text=False if self.fast_mode else True  # Faster without context
                    )
                    
                    text = result["text"].strip()
                    
                    if text:
                        # Append to buffer and display in real-time
                        text_to_append = text  # Capture in local variable
                        self.root.after(0, lambda: self.append_text_realtime(text_to_append))
                        
                except Exception as e:
                    # Continue processing even if one chunk fails
                    pass
                    
            except Exception as e:
                # Continue processing
                pass
                
    def transcribe_final_audio(self):
        """Transcribe any remaining audio after stopping"""
        try:
            if not self.audio_data:
                return
                
            # Convert audio data to numpy array
            audio_array = np.concatenate(self.audio_data, axis=0)
            audio_array = audio_array.flatten()
            
            if len(audio_array) == 0:
                return
            
            # Normalize audio
            max_val = np.max(np.abs(audio_array))
            if max_val > 0:
                audio_array = audio_array / max_val
            
            # Transcribe using Whisper
            result = self.model.transcribe(
                audio_array,
                language=None,
                task="transcribe"
            )
            
            text = result["text"].strip()
            
            # Update UI in main thread
            if text:
                self.root.after(0, lambda: self.append_text(text))
                self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_label.config(
                    text="Final transcription complete!", fg='#4CAF50'
                ))
            else:
                self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_label.config(
                    text="No speech detected", fg='#888888'
                ))
                
        except Exception as e:
            self.root.after(0, lambda: self.show_error(f"Transcription error: {str(e)}"))
            
    def append_text_realtime(self, text):
        """Append transcribed text in real-time (buffered)"""
        if text.strip():
            self.transcription_buffer.append(text)
            # Display accumulated text
            full_text = " ".join(self.transcription_buffer)
            self.root.after(0, lambda: self.update_text_display(full_text))
            
            # Auto-type if enabled (type incrementally)
            if self.auto_type_enabled:
                self.root.after(0, lambda t=text: self.type_text(t))
                
    def update_text_display(self, text):
        """Update the text area with new text"""
        self.text_area.delete("1.0", tk.END)
        self.text_area.insert("1.0", text)
        self.text_area.see(tk.END)
        self.status_label.config(text=f"Transcribing... ({len(self.transcription_buffer)} chunks)", fg='#4CAF50')
            
    def append_text(self, text):
        """Append transcribed text to the text area and optionally type it"""
        if text.strip():
            # Add to text area
            current_text = self.text_area.get("1.0", tk.END)
            if current_text.strip():
                self.text_area.insert(tk.END, " " + text)
            else:
                self.text_area.insert(tk.END, text)
            self.text_area.see(tk.END)
            
            # Auto-type if enabled
            if self.auto_type_enabled:
                self.type_text(text)
                
    def type_text(self, text):
        """Type text using keyboard automation"""
        try:
            # Small delay to ensure focus is on the target application
            time.sleep(0.3)
            # Type the text
            pyautogui.write(text, interval=0.01)  # interval makes typing more natural
            self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_label.config(
                text=f"Typed: {text[:30]}...", fg='#4CAF50'
            ))
        except Exception as e:
            self.root.after(0, lambda: self.show_error(f"Auto-type error: {str(e)}"))
            
    def clear_text(self):
        """Clear the text area and buffer"""
        self.text_area.delete("1.0", tk.END)
        self.transcription_buffer = []
        self.status_label.config(text="Text cleared", fg='#888888')
        
    def copy_text(self):
        """Copy text to clipboard"""
        text = self.text_area.get("1.0", tk.END).strip()
        if text:
            pyperclip.copy(text)
            self.status_label.config(text="Text copied to clipboard!", fg='#4CAF50')
            messagebox.showinfo("Success", "Text copied to clipboard!")
        else:
            messagebox.showwarning("Warning", "No text to copy!")
            
    def save_text(self):
        """Save text to file"""
        text = self.text_area.get("1.0", tk.END).strip()
        if not text:
            messagebox.showwarning("Warning", "No text to save!")
            return
            
        filename = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(
            defaultextension=".txt",
            filetypes=[("Text files", "*.txt"), ("All files", "*.*")],
            initialfile=f"voice_typer_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}.txt"
        )
        
        if filename:
            try:
                with open(filename, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                    f.write(text)
                self.status_label.config(text=f"Saved to {os.path.basename(filename)}", fg='#4CAF50')
                messagebox.showinfo("Success", f"Text saved to {filename}")
            except Exception as e:
                messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Failed to save file: {str(e)}")
                
    def show_error(self, message):
        """Show error message"""
        self.status_label.config(text=f"Error: {message}", fg='#f44336')
        messagebox.showerror("Error", message)

def main():
    """Main function"""
    root = tk.Tk()
    app = VoiceTyper(root)
    
    def on_closing():
        """Cleanup on window close"""
        app.is_listening = False
        app.recording = False
        if hasattr(app, 'global_listener') and app.global_listener:
            app.global_listener.stop()
        root.destroy()
    
    root.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", on_closing)
    root.mainloop()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

        try:

    def _load_model_thread(self):

        try:
            import torch
            
            # Load model on specified device
            self.model = whisper.load_model(self.model_name, device=self.device)
            
            # GPU Optimizations
            if self.device == "cuda":
                # Move model to GPU
                self.model = self.model.to(self.device)
                
                # Use half precision (FP16) for 2x speed boost
                try:
                    self.model = self.model.half()
                    print("✅ Using FP16 precision for 2x speed boost")
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"⚠️ FP16 not available, using FP32: {e}")
                
                # Enable cuDNN optimizations
                torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = True
                torch.backends.cudnn.enabled = True
                
                # Clear GPU cache
                torch.cuda.empty_cache()
                
                print(f"✅ Model loaded on GPU: {torch.cuda.get_device_name(0)}")
                print(f"✅ GPU Memory Used: {torch.cuda.memory_allocated(0) / 1024**3:.2f} GB")

        text_label.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(0, 5))
        
        # Text area with scrollbar
        self.text_area = scrolledtext.ScrolledText(
            text_frame,
            font=('Segoe UI', 12),
            bg='#1e1e1e',
            fg='#ffffff',
            insertbackground='#ffffff',
            wrap=tk.WORD,
            relief=tk.FLAT,
            padx=15,
            pady=15,
            selectbackground='#4CAF50'
        )
        self.text_area.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        
        # Keyboard shortcut info
        shortcut_label = tk.Label(
            main_frame,
            text="⌨️ Press F7 to Start/Stop Recording | ⚡ GPU Optimized for Maximum Speed",
            font=('Segoe UI', 10, 'bold'),
            bg='#2b2b2b',
            fg='#4CAF50'
        )
        shortcut_label.pack(pady=5)
        
        # Info label
        info_label = tk.Label(
            main_frame,
            text="💡 V2 Features: GPU acceleration | 1-second chunks | Ultra-fast transcription\n"
                 "Enable 'Auto-Type' to automatically type transcribed text wherever your cursor is!",
            font=('Segoe UI', 9),
            bg='#2b2b2b',
            fg='#888888',
            wraplength=800,
            justify=tk.LEFT
        )
        info_label.pack(pady=10)
        
    def setup_keyboard_shortcuts(self):
        """Setup global keyboard shortcuts"""
        self.root.bind('<F7>', lambda e: self.toggle_recording())
        try:
            from pynput import keyboard
            def on_press(key):
                try:
                    if key == keyboard.Key.f7:
                        self.root.after(0, self.toggle_recording)
                except AttributeError:
                    pass
            self.global_listener = keyboard.Listener(on_press=on_press)
            self.global_listener.start()
        except ImportError:
            self.global_listener = None
        
    def toggle_auto_type(self):
        """Toggle auto-type feature"""
        self.auto_type_enabled = self.auto_type_var.get()
        if self.auto_type_enabled:
            self.status_label.config(text="Auto-Type ENABLED - Click where you want to type, then speak!", fg='#4CAF50')
        else:
            self.status_label.config(text="Auto-Type disabled", fg='#888888')
        
    def toggle_recording(self):
        """Start or stop recording"""
        if not self.is_listening:
            self.start_recording()
        else:
            self.stop_recording()
            
    def start_recording(self):
        """Start recording with GPU-optimized real-time transcription"""
        if not self.model:
            messagebox.showwarning("Warning", "Model is still loading. Please wait...")
            return
            
        self.is_listening = True
        self.recording = True
        self.audio_data = []
        self.transcription_buffer = []
        
        self.listen_button.config(
            text="⏹️ Stop Recording (F7)",
            bg='#f44336',
            activebackground='#da190b'
        )
        self.status_label.config(text="🎤 Recording... Transcribing in real-time!", fg='#f44336')
        self.mic_status_label.config(fg='#f44336')
        
        # Start recording thread
        self.record_thread = threading.Thread(target=self.record_audio_realtime, daemon=True)
        self.record_thread.start()
        
        # Start GPU-accelerated transcription processor
        self.transcription_thread = threading.Thread(target=self.process_realtime_transcription_gpu, daemon=True)
        self.transcription_thread.start()
        
    def stop_recording(self):
        """Stop recording"""
        self.recording = False
        self.is_listening = False
        
        self.listen_button.config(
            text="🎤 Start Recording (F7)",
            bg='#4CAF50',
            activebackground='#45a049'
        )
        self.status_label.config(text="Stopped. Processing final audio...", fg='#FF9800')
        self.mic_status_label.config(fg='#666666')
        
        # Process any remaining audio
        if self.audio_data:
            threading.Thread(target=self.transcribe_final_audio, daemon=True).start()
        
    def record_audio_realtime(self):
        """Record audio continuously with 1-second chunks"""
        try:
            chunk_samples = int(self.sample_rate * self.chunk_duration)
            current_chunk = []
            chunk_sample_count = 0
            
            def audio_callback(indata, frames, time, status):
                if self.recording:
                    current_chunk.append(indata.copy())
                    nonlocal chunk_sample_count
                    chunk_sample_count += frames
                    
                    if chunk_sample_count >= chunk_samples:
                        chunk_audio = np.concatenate(current_chunk, axis=0)
                        if len(chunk_audio) > 0:
                            self.audio_queue.put(chunk_audio.copy())
                        current_chunk.clear()
                        chunk_sample_count = 0
                    
            with sd.InputStream(
                samplerate=self.sample_rate,
                channels=1,
                dtype='float32',
                callback=audio_callback,
                blocksize=self.sample_rate // 20
            ):
                while self.recording:
                    sd.sleep(50)
                    
            if current_chunk:
                chunk_audio = np.concatenate(current_chunk, axis=0)
                if len(chunk_audio) > 0:
                    self.audio_queue.put(chunk_audio.copy())
                    
        except Exception as e:
            self.root.after(0, lambda: self.show_error(f"Recording error: {str(e)}"))
            self.is_listening = False
            
    def process_realtime_transcription_gpu(self):
        """GPU-accelerated real-time transcription processing"""
        import torch
        
        while self.is_listening or not self.audio_queue.empty():
            try:
                try:
                    audio_chunk = self.audio_queue.get(timeout=0.3)
                except queue.Empty:
                    continue
                
                if audio_chunk is None or len(audio_chunk) == 0:
                    continue
                
                # Normalize audio
                audio_array = audio_chunk.flatten()
                if len(audio_array) == 0:
                    continue
                    
                max_val = np.max(np.abs(audio_array))
                if max_val > 0:
                    audio_array = audio_array / max_val
                
                # GPU-optimized transcription
                try:
                    with torch.no_grad():  # Disable gradient computation for speed
                        result = self.model.transcribe(
                            audio_array,
                            language=None,
                            task="transcribe",
                            fp16=(self.device == "cuda"),  # Use FP16 on GPU
                            beam_size=1,  # Fast decoding
                            best_of=1,  # Single pass
                            temperature=0.0,  # Deterministic
                            compression_ratio_threshold=2.4,
                            logprob_threshold=-1.0,
                            no_speech_threshold=0.6,
                            condition_on_previous_text=False  # Faster without context
                        )
                    
                    text = result["text"].strip()
                    
                    if text:
                        self.root.after(0, lambda t=text: self.append_text_realtime(t))
                        
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"Transcription error: {e}")
                    pass
                    
            except Exception as e:
                pass
                
    def append_text_realtime(self, text):
        """Append transcribed text in real-time"""
        if text.strip():
            self.transcription_buffer.append(text)
            full_text = " ".join(self.transcription_buffer)
            self.root.after(0, lambda: self.update_text_display(full_text))
            
            if self.auto_type_enabled:
                self.root.after(0, lambda t=text: self.type_text(t))
                
    def update_text_display(self, text):
        """Update the text area with new text"""
        self.text_area.delete("1.0", tk.END)
        self.text_area.insert("1.0", text)
        self.text_area.see(tk.END)
        chunks = len(self.transcription_buffer)
        self.status_label.config(text=f"⚡ Transcribing... ({chunks} chunks)", fg='#4CAF50')
            
    def type_text(self, text):
        """Type text using keyboard automation"""
        try:
            time.sleep(0.2)
            pyautogui.write(text, interval=0.005)  # Very fast typing
            self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_label.config(
                text=f"⚡ Typed: {text[:30]}...", fg='#4CAF50'
            ))
        except Exception as e:
            self.root.after(0, lambda: self.show_error(f"Auto-type error: {str(e)}"))
            
    def transcribe_final_audio(self):
        """Transcribe any remaining audio after stopping"""
        try:
            if not self.audio_data:
                return
                
            audio_array = np.concatenate(self.audio_data, axis=0)
            audio_array = audio_array.flatten()
            
            if len(audio_array) == 0:
                return
            
            max_val = np.max(np.abs(audio_array))
            if max_val > 0:
                audio_array = audio_array / max_val
            
            import torch
            with torch.no_grad():
                result = self.model.transcribe(
                    audio_array,
                    language=None,
                    task="transcribe",
                    fp16=(self.device == "cuda")
                )
            
            text = result["text"].strip()
            
            if text:
                self.root.after(0, lambda: self.append_text(text))
                self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_label.config(
                    text="✅ Final transcription complete!", fg='#4CAF50'
                ))
            else:
                self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_label.config(
                    text="No speech detected", fg='#888888'
                ))
                
        except Exception as e:
            self.root.after(0, lambda: self.show_error(f"Transcription error: {str(e)}"))
            
    def append_text(self, text):
        """Append transcribed text"""
        if text.strip():
            current_text = self.text_area.get("1.0", tk.END)
            if current_text.strip():
                self.text_area.insert(tk.END, " " + text)
            else:
                self.text_area.insert(tk.END, text)
            self.text_area.see(tk.END)
            
            if self.auto_type_enabled:
                self.type_text(text)
                
    def clear_text(self):
        """Clear the text area and buffer"""
        self.text_area.delete("1.0", tk.END)
        self.transcription_buffer = []
        self.status_label.config(text="Text cleared", fg='#888888')
        
    def copy_text(self):
        """Copy text to clipboard"""
        text = self.text_area.get("1.0", tk.END).strip()
        if text:
            pyperclip.copy(text)
            self.status_label.config(text="Text copied to clipboard!", fg='#4CAF50')
            messagebox.showinfo("Success", "Text copied to clipboard!")
        else:
            messagebox.showwarning("Warning", "No text to copy!")
            
    def save_text(self):
        """Save text to file"""
        text = self.text_area.get("1.0", tk.END).strip()
        if not text:
            messagebox.showwarning("Warning", "No text to save!")
            return
            
        filename = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(
            defaultextension=".txt",
            filetypes=[("Text files", "*.txt"), ("All files", "*.*")],
            initialfile=f"voice_typer_v2_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}.txt"
        )
        
        if filename:
            try:
                with open(filename, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                    f.write(text)
                self.status_label.config(text=f"Saved to {os.path.basename(filename)}", fg='#4CAF50')
                messagebox.showinfo("Success", f"Text saved to {filename}")
            except Exception as e:
                messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Failed to save file: {str(e)}")
                
    def show_error(self, message):
        """Show error message"""
        self.status_label.config(text=f"Error: {message}", fg='#f44336')
        messagebox.showerror("Error", message)

def main():
    """Main function"""
    root = tk.Tk()
    app = VoiceTyperV2GPU(root)
    
    def on_closing():
        """Cleanup on window close"""
        app.is_listening = False
        app.recording = False
        if hasattr(app, 'global_listener') and app.global_listener:
            app.global_listener.stop()
        root.destroy()
    
    root.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", on_closing)
    root.mainloop()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# PCB IQC Result - Complete Workflow Documentation

## Overview
The PCB IQC (Incoming Quality Control) Result system is designed to track and manage PCB quality testing results. It allows users to scan PCB serial numbers, enter test results, and maintain a batch view of all PCBs.

## Document Structure

### Main Document: PCB IQC Result
- **Purpose**: Master document that tracks IQC results for a batch of PCBs
- **Key Fields**:
  - **PCB**: The PCB Item Code (e.g., "PA01 0001")
  - **pcb_scan**: Input field for scanning PCB serial numbers

### Two Child Tables

#### 1. PCB IQC Data Enter (Top Table)
- **Purpose**: Single-row input interface for entering/updating PCB test results
- **Behavior**: 
  - Limited to **1 row only**
  - Used for data entry and editing
  - Acts as a "working area" for current PCB being processed
- **Key Fields**:
  - PCB Serial No (required)
  - Overall Status (Pass/Fail/Pending)
  - PTS1 Status, PTS2 Status, PTS3 Status (Pass/Fail/Pending)
  - PTS1 Date, PTS2 Date, PTS3 Date
  - Dominant Channel
  - Max Value
  - Remarks

#### 2. pcb Table (Bottom Table - PCB IQC Line)
- **Purpose**: Batch view showing all PCBs in the current document
- **Behavior**:
  - Can have **multiple rows** (infinite)
  - Read-only view (for display purposes)
  - Shows all PCBs that have been scanned/entered
- **Key Fields**: Same as PCB IQC Data Enter

## Complete Workflow

### Step 1: Create New Document
1. User creates a new "PCB IQC Result" document
2. User selects the **PCB Item** (e.g., "PA01 0001")
3. User **SAVES the document first** (this is critical!)

### Step 2: Scan PCB Serial Number
1. User enters PCB serial number in **pcb_scan** field (e.g., "SLB250202000534")
2. User presses **Enter** key OR clicks **"Search PCB"** button
3. System searches for this serial number in the **pcb table** (bottom table)

### Step 3: Search Results

#### Scenario A: PCB Found in pcb Table
- System loads existing data from pcb table into **PCB IQC Data Enter** table (top table)
- User can see all previous test results
- User can update/modify the results

#### Scenario B: PCB NOT Found in pcb Table
- System adds the serial number to **PCB IQC Data Enter** table (top table)
- System **automatically adds** a new row to **pcb table** (bottom table) with:
  - Serial number
  - Default status: "Pending" for all PTS tests
  - Current date for IQC date
- User can now enter test results

### Step 4: Enter/Update Test Results
1. User enters test results in **PCB IQC Data Enter** table (top table):
   - Changes PTS1 Status, PTS2 Status, PTS3 Status to "Pass" or "Fail"
   - Dates are automatically set when status changes from "Pending"
   - Overall Status is automatically calculated:
     - **Fail** if any PTS test is "Fail"
     - **Pass** if all PTS tests are "Pass"
     - **Pending** otherwise
   - User can enter Dominant Channel, Max Value, Remarks

### Step 5: Submit PCB Data
1. User clicks **"Submit PCB Data"** button
2. System finds the matching row in **pcb table** (bottom table) by serial number
3. System **updates** the row in **pcb table** with data from **PCB IQC Data Enter** table
4. System clears **PCB IQC Data Enter** table (ready for next PCB)
5. System **auto-saves** the document
6. Success message is shown

### Step 6: Repeat for Next PCB
1. User scans next PCB serial number
2. Process repeats from Step 2

## Button Functions

### 1. Submit PCB Data
- **When to use**: After entering/updating test results in PCB IQC Data Enter table
- **What it does**:
  - Updates existing row in pcb table with data from PCB IQC Data Enter
  - Clears PCB IQC Data Enter table
  - Auto-saves document
- **Requirements**: 
  - Document must be saved (not new)
  - PCB must exist in pcb table (must be scanned first)

### 2. Search PCB
- **When to use**: To manually search for a PCB serial number
- **What it does**:
  - Opens a dialog box
  - User enters serial number
  - Triggers the same search logic as Enter key

### 3. Filter Batch
- **When to use**: To filter the pcb table by batch prefix
- **What it does**: (To be implemented)
  - Filters pcb table to show only PCBs matching batch prefix
  - Example: Filter by "SLB250202" shows all PCBs starting with that prefix

## Enter Key Behavior

### When Enter is pressed in pcb_scan field:
1. **If document is NEW**:
   - Clears any existing child rows
   - Saves the document first
   - Reloads the form
   - Then adds PCB to tables

2. **If document is SAVED**:
   - Immediately searches and adds PCB to tables

## Status Color Coding

- **Pass**: Green background (#d4edda), dark green text (#155724), bold
- **Fail**: Red background (#f8d7da), dark red text (#721c24), bold
- **Pending**: Yellow background (#fff3cd), dark yellow text (#856404), normal weight

## Important Rules

1. **Document must be saved before scanning**: This prevents parent reference errors
2. **PCB IQC Data Enter is single-row only**: Only one PCB can be edited at a time
3. **pcb table is batch view**: Shows all PCBs in the document
4. **Auto-save after submit**: Document is automatically saved after successful submit
5. **Auto-date tracking**: Dates are automatically set when status changes from "Pending"
6. **Auto-status calculation**: Overall Status is calculated based on PTS1, PTS2, PTS3 statuses

## Data Flow

```
User scans serial → Search in pcb table
                    ↓
              Found? ──No──→ Add to PCB IQC Data Enter + Add to pcb table
                    │
                   Yes
                    ↓
         Load data into PCB IQC Data Enter
                    ↓
         User updates test results
                    ↓
         User clicks "Submit PCB Data"
                    ↓
         Update row in pcb table
                    ↓
         Clear PCB IQC Data Enter
                    ↓
         Auto-save document
```

## Error Handling

### Common Errors and Solutions

1. **"Could not find Row #1: Parent: new-pcb-iqc-result-xxx"**
   - **Cause**: Trying to add child rows before document is saved
   - **Solution**: Document must be saved first before scanning

2. **"Please enter PCB data in PCB IQC Data Enter table"**
   - **Cause**: Submit button clicked but table is empty
   - **Solution**: Scan a PCB serial number first

3. **"PCB not found in pcb table"**
   - **Cause**: Trying to submit data for PCB that hasn't been scanned
   - **Solution**: Scan the PCB serial number first

## Best Practices

1. **Always save document first** before scanning any PCB serial numbers
2. **One PCB at a time**: Use PCB IQC Data Enter for one PCB, submit, then move to next
3. **Use Enter key**: Faster workflow - just scan and press Enter
4. **Check pcb table**: Use bottom table to see all PCBs in the batch
5. **Submit after changes**: Always click "Submit PCB Data" after entering/updating results

## Technical Notes

- **Child Tables**: Both tables are child tables linked to PCB IQC Result document
- **Parent Fields**: Automatically set when document is saved
- **Client Script**: Handles all UI interactions and data flow
- **Server Script**: Handles validation and data persistence
- **Auto-calculation**: Overall Status and dates are calculated automatically

---

**Last Updated**: January 2026
**Version**: 1.0

"""
Automated Frappe Console Command Executor
Executes Python commands in Frappe console without manual typing
"""
import subprocess
import sys
import os

def execute_frappe_command(command, site='frontend', show_output=True):
    """
    Execute a Python command in Frappe console
    
    Args:
        command: Python command to execute (string)
        site: Frappe site name (default: 'frontend')
        show_output: Whether to print output (default: True)
    
    Returns:
        tuple: (success: bool, output: str, error: str)
    """
    try:
        # Prepare the command with exit
        full_command = f"{command}\nexit()\n"
        
        # Docker compose exec command
        docker_cmd = [
            'docker', 'compose', 'exec', '-T', 'backend',
            'bench', '--site', site, 'console'
        ]
        
        if show_output:
            print(f"\n{'='*80}")
            print(f"Executing: {command[:100]}...")
            print(f"{'='*80}\n")
        
        # Determine working directory (where docker-compose.yml is located)
        # Try common locations
        possible_dirs = [
            r'G:\frappe_docker-main\frappe_docker-main',
            os.path.join(os.path.expanduser('~'), 'Desktop', 'frappe_docker-main', 'frappe_docker-main'),
            os.path.join(os.path.expanduser('~'), 'frappe_docker-main', 'frappe_docker-main'),
            os.getcwd(),  # Current directory
        ]
        
        working_dir = None
        for dir_path in possible_dirs:
            if dir_path and os.path.exists(dir_path):
                # Check for docker-compose.yml or docker-compose.yaml
                if (os.path.exists(os.path.join(dir_path, 'docker-compose.yml')) or 
                    os.path.exists(os.path.join(dir_path, 'docker-compose.yaml'))):
                    working_dir = dir_path
                    break
        
        if not working_dir:
            # Fallback: use current directory or try to find it
            working_dir = os.getcwd()
            if show_output:
                print(f"Warning: Using current directory: {working_dir}")
        
        # Execute command with UTF-8 encoding
        result = subprocess.run(
            docker_cmd,
            input=full_command,
            text=True,
            capture_output=True,
            cwd=working_dir,
            encoding='utf-8',
            errors='replace'  # Replace encoding errors instead of failing
        )
        
        # Extract output (remove IPython prompts and exit prompt)
        if result.stdout:
            output_lines = result.stdout.split('\n')
        else:
            output_lines = []
            
        cleaned_output = []
        skip_until_prompt = False
        
        for line in output_lines:
            # Skip IPython startup messages
            if 'Apps in this namespace:' in line:
                skip_until_prompt = True
                continue
            if skip_until_prompt and line.strip().startswith('In ['):
                skip_until_prompt = False
                continue
            if skip_until_prompt:
                continue
            # Skip exit prompt
            if 'Do you really want to exit' in line:
                continue
            if line.strip().startswith('In ['):
                continue
            cleaned_output.append(line)
        
        output = '\n'.join(cleaned_output).strip()
        error = result.stderr.strip() if result.stderr else ""
        
        if show_output:
            if output:
                print(output)
            if error:
                print(f"\nERROR:\n{error}", file=sys.stderr)
            print(f"\n{'='*80}")
            print(f"Return Code: {result.returncode}")
            print(f"{'='*80}\n")
        
        success = result.returncode == 0
        
        return success, output, error
        
    except FileNotFoundError:
        error_msg = "Error: 'docker' command not found. Make sure Docker is installed and in PATH."
        if show_output:
            print(error_msg, file=sys.stderr)
        return False, "", error_msg
    except Exception as e:
        error_msg = f"Error executing command: {str(e)}"
        if show_output:
            print(error_msg, file=sys.stderr)
        return False, "", error_msg


def execute_python_file(file_path, site='frontend', show_output=True):
    """
    Execute a Python file in Frappe console
    
    Args:
        file_path: Path to Python file (relative to /home/frappe/frappe-bench/sites/frontend/)
        site: Frappe site name (default: 'frontend')
        show_output: Whether to print output (default: True)
    
    Returns:
        tuple: (success: bool, output: str, error: str)
    """
    command = f"exec(open('{file_path}').read())"
    return execute_frappe_command(command, site, show_output)


def execute_multiple_commands(commands, site='frontend', show_output=True):
    """
    Execute multiple Python commands sequentially
    
    Args:
        commands: List of Python commands to execute
        site: Frappe site name (default: 'frontend')
        show_output: Whether to print output (default: True)
    
    Returns:
        list: List of (success, output, error) tuples for each command
    """
    results = []
    for i, cmd in enumerate(commands, 1):
        if show_output:
            print(f"\n[{i}/{len(commands)}] Executing command...")
        success, output, error = execute_frappe_command(cmd, site, show_output)
        results.append((success, output, error))
    return results


# Example usage functions
def example_usage():
    """Show example usage"""
    print("""
Example Usage:

# 1. Execute a single command
success, output, error = execute_frappe_command("frappe.db.get_all('PCB Master', limit=5)")

# 2. Execute a Python file
success, output, error = execute_python_file('/home/frappe/frappe-bench/sites/frontend/FIX_EVERYTHING_AT_ONCE.py')

# 3. Execute multiple commands
commands = [
    "doc = frappe.get_doc('PCB IQC Result', '7cuds4chvt')",
    "print(f'Document: {doc.name}')",
    "print(f'Status: {doc.docstatus}')"
]
results = execute_multiple_commands(commands)

# 4. Quick test
test_command = "print('Hello from Frappe Console!')"
execute_frappe_command(test_command)
""")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Test the function
    print("="*80)
    print("Frappe Console Auto-Executor")
    print("="*80)

# PCB Ledger Complete History System

## Overview

Transform PCB Ledger from event-based entries to a "one file per PCB" system that stores:

- Complete master snapshot at every event
- Full timeline from inbound → testing → assembly → customer
- Lifecycle stage tracking
- Warehouse movement history
- Test result history
- Reference document links

## Architecture

### Current State

- **PCB Ledger**: One document per event (many documents per PCB)
- **PCB Master**: Current state only (no history)

### Target State

- **PCB Ledger**: One document per PCB serial (contains timeline child table)
- **PCB Ledger Timeline**: Child table with append-only events
- Each timeline entry includes: master snapshot JSON + event payload JSON

## Data Model Design

### 1. PCB Ledger DocType (One per PCB Serial)

#### Identity Fields

- `name`: PCB Serial Number (Primary Key, e.g., "SLC001")
- `pcb_serial_no`: Data (Required) - PCB serial number
- `item_code`: Link → Item
- `pcb_revision`: Data (Optional)
- `batch_no`: Data (Optional)
- `manufacturing_lot`: Data (Optional)

#### Lifecycle Tracking

- `lifecycle_stage`: Select
  - Options: `INBOUND` → `INCOMING_QC` → `PTS_TESTING` → `STORES` → `ASSEMBLY` → `REJECTED` → `SCRAP`
- `first_received_on`: Datetime
- `first_tested_on`: Datetime
- `first_shipped_on`: Datetime (for future)
- `last_event_time`: Datetime
- `last_known_location`: Link → Warehouse
- `total_test_count`: Int
- `total_rework_count`: Int

#### Current Snapshot (Mirrors PCB Master)

- `overall_status`: Select (NEW, PTS_PENDING, PASS, FAIL, REJECTED_ASSEMBLY, REWORKED)
- `current_warehouse`: Link → Warehouse
- `pts1_status`: Select (Pass, Fail, NA, Pending)
- `pts2_status`: Select (Pass, Fail, NA, Pending)
- `pts3_status`: Select (Pass, Fail, NA, Pending)
- `dominant_channel`: Select (Balanced, Left, Right)
- `max_value`: Float
- `remark`: Small Text
- `iqc_date`: Date
- `last_tested_on`: Datetime
- `last_event_ref_doctype`: Data
- `last_event_ref_docname`: Data

### 2. PCB Ledger Timeline (Child Table)

#### Event Fields

- `event_time`: Datetime (Required)
- `event_type`: Select (Required)
- `stage_after_event`: Select (lifecycle stage after this event)
- `actor_user`: Link → User
- `from_location`: Link → Warehouse
- `to_location`: Link → Warehouse
- `ref_doctype`: Data (Source document type)
- `ref_docname`: Data (Source document name)
- `remarks`: Small Text

#### Snapshot Fields

- `master_snapshot_json`: Long Text (JSON) - Complete PCB Master state at this moment
- `extra_payload_json`: Long Text (JSON) - Event-specific additional data

### 3. Event Types (Complete List)

#### Receiving/Inventory

- `CREATED`: PCB Master created
- `RECEIVED_IN_OFFICE`: Purchase Receipt received
- `MOVED_TO_INCOMING_QC`: Stock Entry to IncomingQC warehouse
- `MOVED_TO_PTS_TESTING`: Stock Entry to PTS Testing warehouse
- `MOVED_TO_STORES`: Stock Entry (PCB IQC Accept) to Stores
- `MOVED_TO_ASSEMBLY`: Stock Entry (Material Transfer for Manufacturing) to Assembly
- `MOVED_TO_REJECTED`: Stock Entry (PCB IQC Reject or Rejected from Assembly) to Rejected Items

#### Testing

- `IQC_SUBMITTED`: PCB IQC Result submitted
- `PTS1_UPDATED`: PTS1 test result recorded
- `PTS2_UPDATED`: PTS2 test result recorded
- `PTS3_UPDATED`: PTS3 test result recorded
- `STATUS_COMPUTED`: Overall status calculated

## Implementation Steps

### Phase 1: Restructure PCB Ledger DocType

#### Step 1.1: Create New PCB Ledger Structure

**File**: Create/modify DocType via Python script

- Change from event-based to PCB-based (one doc per serial)
- Add lifecycle tracking fields
- Add current snapshot fields (mirror PCB Master)
- Create child table "PCB Ledger Timeline"

#### Step 1.2: Create PCB Ledger Timeline Child Table

**File**: New DocType "PCB Ledger Timeline"

- Fields: event_time, event_type, stage_after_event, actor_user, from_location, to_location, ref_doctype, ref_docname, remarks, master_snapshot_json, extra_payload_json
- Set as child table
- Link to PCB Ledger

### Phase 2: Create Common Ledger Update Function

#### Step 2.1: Create API Module

**File**: `erpnext/stock/doctype/pcb_ledger/pcb_ledger_api.py`

- Function: `update_pcb_ledger(pcb_serial_no, event_type, ref_doctype, ref_docname, from_location, to_location, master_snapshot, extra_payload)`
- Logic:

  1. Get or create PCB Ledger document (name = pcb_serial_no)
  2. Get current PCB Master state
  3. Create master snapshot JSON
  4. Append timeline entry with snapshot
  5. Update PCB Ledger current snapshot fields
  6. Update lifecycle stage
  7. Save

### Phase 3: Integrate with Existing Workflows

#### Step 3.1: PCB IQC Result Integration

**File**: Modify `pcb_iqc_result_api.py`

- After updating PCB Master, call `update_pcb_ledger()`
- Event types: `IQC_SUBMITTED`, `PTS1_UPDATED`, `PTS2_UPDATED`, `PTS3_UPDATED`
- Master snapshot: All PCB Master fields at that moment
- Extra payload: Test results, machine ID, operator notes

#### Step 3.2: Stock Entry Integration

**File**: Create/modify Stock Entry server script

- Hook: `on_submit`
- Detect PCB serial numbers in Stock Entry items
- Determine event type based on Stock Entry Type:
  - `PCB-IQC-Accept` → `MOVED_TO_STORES`
  - `PCB-IQC-Reject` → `MOVED_TO_REJECTED`
  - `Rejected from Assembly` → `MOVED_TO_REJECTED`
  - `Material Transfer for Manufacturing` → `MOVED_TO_ASSEMBLY`
  - Material Transfer (IncomingQC → PTS Testing) → `MOVED_TO_PTS_TESTING`
- Call `update_pcb_ledger()` for each PCB

#### Step 3.3: Purchase Receipt Integration

**File**: Create Purchase Receipt server script

- Hook: `on_submit`
- Detect PCB serial numbers
- Event type: `RECEIVED_IN_OFFICE`
- Update lifecycle stage: `INBOUND`
- Call `update_pcb_ledger()`

### Phase 4: Master Snapshot Function

#### Step 4.1: Create Snapshot Builder

**File**: `pcb_ledger_api.py`

- Function: `build_master_snapshot(pcb_serial_no)`
- Returns: Dict with all PCB Master fields
- Fields to include:
  - pcb_serial_no, item_code
  - overall_status, pts1_status, pts2_status, pts3_status
  - dominant_channel, max_value, remark
  - iqc_date, last_tested_on
  - last_warehouse, last_event_ref_doctype, last_event_ref_docname
  - created, modified

### Phase 5: Migration Strategy

#### Step 5.1: Migrate Existing Data

**File**: Migration script

- Read all existing PCB Ledger entries
- Group by pcb_serial_no
- Create new PCB Ledger documents (one per serial)
- Convert old entries to timeline entries
- Reconstruct master snapshots from historical data where possible

├── pcb_ledger/
│   ├── pcb_ledger.json (DocType definition)
│   ├── pcb_ledger.py (DocType class)

LIFECYCLE_STAGE_MAP = {
